entry.title: Dragonfly Early Reflections 1.3.1
entry.summary: The plugin's MPC name is now the full **Early Reflections** (was the abbreviated `Early Refl`), so the insert slot, the plugin browser and the page folder all read the full name. The catalog zips follow: `Early-Reflections-<version>-mpc-armv7.zip` and `-mpc-aarch64.zip`. Unchanged: the plugin id `dragonfly-early-reflections`, the VST uid `44664572`, every parameter, the page layout and the DSP. Hall, Room and Plate are untouched.
